position_has_positive_upnl.meaning: the position has positive unrealized PnL high enough that the user can withdraw initial margin via removeMargin

backstop_liquidation_occurs.meaning: a backstop liquidation of the position occurs

backstop_liquidation_scope.meaning: the liquidation is a backstop liquidation, i.e. it falls within the backstop-liquidator reward scope rather than an ordinary liquidation

backstop_rewards_paid.meaning: rewards for backstop liquidators are paid rather than avoided

assumptions: The user is the position owner and calls removeMargin on their own position.
The backstop liquidation scenario is conditional on the position later becoming liquidatable.
Positive uPNL is treated as a qualitative condition since no numeric threshold is reported.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric threshold for 'high enough pnl' or the minimum margin requirement, so the PnL sufficiency condition is represented as a grounded Boolean.
Report does not establish a prior transaction showing margin was already withdrawn before the backstop liquidation; the liquidation scenario is conditional.

limitations: Only the backstop-liquidator reward impact is formalized; the liquidation-fee avoidance and bad-debt impacts are handled in separate passes.
The reward amount is not quantified in the report, so the effect is a Boolean occurrence rather than a numeric payment relation.
The link between the margin withdrawal and the later backstop liquidation is not fully specified in the report.
The backstop scope qualifier is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report does not define the numeric or structural boundary between backstop and ordinary liquidations.
